canonical_project: Vantage Data Centre Bro Tathan (CWL2, St Athan)

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Vantage data centre at Bro Tathan, St Athan approved at Vale of Glamorgan committee for 120MW (Sept 2025, per Vantage Bridgend coverage); Welsh Ministers subsequently submitted plans to Vale of Glamorgan Council to demolish buildings and build a 132kV electricity substation at Bro Tathan; staged development.
